the top of the window as bullet comments, while the composer keeps its place.
# DliDli

Danmaku and live-chat overlays for DSH. The model's
streaming reasoning and answer can be shown in t
wo ways, switchable at runtime:

- **Live mode** — a chat-style timeline in the right-hand column. New sentences appear
at the bottom

, older ones move up, and each row fades out after its own lifetime
(adjustable), so a finished answ

er does not stay on screen forever.
- **Danmaku mode** — Bilibili-style bullets flying right to left

across the full window
width, with configurable speed, lane count and collision-free scheduling.
## Features

- Reads the transcript one `assistant-step` node at a time, in DOM order, so reasoning
and answer ke

ep the order the model produced them.
- History never replays: the first tick only baselines existin

g nodes (new nodes that
appear during the first eight seconds after a reload are treated as history

too).
- Content cleanup: code fences, URLs and markdown punctuation are stripped; purely
Latin fragm

ents are skipped when the "filter English/code fragments" switch is on.
- Semantic edit announcement

s: while an `edit`/`write` call streams, the band reports
`修改 <file>` / `新增类 <name>` as those declar

ations arrive — no line/character
counters.
- Two settings surfaces that adapt to the mode:
- live:

thinking, filters, colours, demo.
- The transcript is hidden while the overlay is on; the composer k

eeps its place.
- One merged settings panel (tabs `弹幕` / `外观`); the floating gear sits below the
tit

le bar, and the title-bar menu can open the same panel.
- Sidebar collapses on start (optional).
## Shortcuts

- `Ctrl+Shift+D` — toggle the overlay
- `Ctrl+Shift+M` — emit a demo line

## Safety

Polling only (140 ms), no `MutationObserver` on the document, and DOM writes happen only
when new te

xt arrives — an earlier attempt at a similar feature froze the UI by writing
